scope: One rendered page per added source, visually inspected; not a full layout audit

observations.finding: Government objective precedes the envelope display; a secondary scope discussion is in a footnote. Dense vectors remain in prose, so readability is not uniformly minimal.
A verbal two-part value precedes the dynamic equation; definitions and interpretation follow it before the next decision.
The theorem's three cases and subcases are visually separated. The proof keeps the two derivatives and the inequality in a consecutive chain.
A dense scalar-to-matrix derivation makes dimensions and weights explicit. It is evidence of sequencing, not a recommendation to fit this much algebra on every page.
Direct and indirect terms receive short underbrace labels; the following prose interprets exposure and reduced-form elasticities separately.
Subheadings divide capital, goods clearing, and value-function tasks. The notes immediately after share equations explain subscript orientation.
The specification is introduced before its display and coefficient interpretation; the next heading changes from evidence to mechanism.
A numbered verbal recovery sequence leads to an inversion display; normalization is stated immediately below it.
